title: Extreme & Verification Lab
prompt:
PAGE 6 & PAGE 7: Extreme Weather Early Warning & Model Verification Lab.

1. Extreme Weather Alert Tabs:
   - Active Tab Switcher: [Heavy Rainfall] | [Heatwave / Tmax] | [High Wind & Gusts]
   - Cyclone Track Disagreement & Preservation Callout:
     * Callout Banner: 'CRITICAL EVENT PRESERVATION: Cyclone track bifurcation detected in Arabian Sea. NCUM-G projects landfall at Saurashtra (Gujarat), GraphCast projects track northward toward Sindh. The Weathermix adaptive fusion engine preserves the extreme probability peak at 72% rather than dampening the peak through naive ensemble averaging.'
   - Exceedance Probability Map & Affected Districts:
     * P(Rain >= 115.5 mm/24h Very Heavy Rain): Warm severity ramp (sand #E9DFCB -> amber #D9A441 -> copper #C4713B -> brick #A63D2F).
     * High-risk districts: Raigad (89%), Ratnagiri (84%), Thane (76%), Mumbai Suburban (72%), Valsad (68%).
   - Peak Risk Timeline (Next 72 hours hourly risk distribution).

2. Verification Lab Scorecards (Evaluating AI vs Physics vs Blend):
   - Truth Source Toggle: [IMD Gridded 0.25°] | [ERA5 Reanalysis] | [AWS Surface Network]
   - Circularity Caution Note: 'Notice: ERA5 verification against AIFS/GraphCast contains reanalysis training overlap; IMD station AWS provides independent ground truth.'
   - Skill Metric Comparison Table:
     * Metrics: RMSE (lower is better), MAE, ACC (Anomaly Correlation Coeff), CRPS (Continuous Ranked Probability Score), Brier Score, CSI (Critical Success Index).
     * Values for NCUM-G, BharatFS, GraphCast, AIFS, and Weathermix Blend.
     * Highlight Badge: '★ Hybrid Blend cuts RMSE by 14.2% and increases CSI for extreme rain by 18.6% over best single model.'
   - Chronological Dataset Split: Train (2017-2021) | Validation (2022) | Holdout Test (2023-2025).
